text:
Vik: Quick PR up for a small tidy that tightens the on-prem auth surface: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4129 - removes old SHARED_SECRET env usage and switches to per-project tokens. Added a couple lightweight unit tests. Need a quick sec/privacy check before today's merge window (3:00pm PST).

security-bot: secret-scan v2: no high-entropy secrets found in the diff. Automated linting passed. Manual review recommended for KMS policy scope and RBAC.

Anna: can you paste the k8s Secret/ServiceAccount manifest snippet here? want to confirm there isn't a broad SA binding or clusterRole accidentally added.

Vik: sure — manifest snippet (sensitive values redacted):
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: onprem-auth
  namespace: infra-onprem
data:
  token: <redacted-base64>
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: onprem-auth-sa
  namespace: infra-onprem
```
RBAC change: bind only to role `onprem-auth-role` in namespace `infra-onprem` (no clusterRole).

Rahul: skimmed the PR. policy: narrow KMS key usage to encrypt/decrypt and add an IAM condition for `resource.name` or `request.auth.claims.namespace == "infra-onprem"`. If you want I can push a tiny policy tweak as a follow-up but it's not a blocker.

Sam: merge window reminder — we close merges at 3:30pm PST today. CI is green currently, but we need one more sec approval to merge. @Luis can you take a look?

Luis: taking a quick look now. LGTM for security posture. One small ask: add a two-line changelog entry and note rollback steps in the runbook (where to flip the feature flag and how to redeploy the old secret). :thumbsup:

Vik: awesome, thanks everyone. I'll merge at ~3:05pm after final CI job finishes, then open a follow-up for the KMS policy tweak and add the changelog + runbook note. :rocket:
